description: This file defines the PendingSelfReviewSummary class in the OrangeHRM project, implementing the ActionSummary interface. It manages the retrieval of pending self-review counts for a specific employee, utilizing filtering parameters and service traits. It is part of the dashboard's action summary DTOs related to actionable review statuses.

classes.name: PendingSelfReviewSummary
classes.description: A class that summarizes pending self-reviews for an employee, providing group ID, group name, and count of pending actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes review filter parameters with employee number and predefined statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the static group ID for this review summary.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the description of this review group.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves count of pending self-reviews using the configured filter parameters.
